description: Signpost (not a knowledge pack) for the railway RAMS and signalling assurance standards: EN 50126-1:2017 and EN 50126-2:2017 (both with A1:2024) for the RAMS process, EN 50128:2011 (A1:2020, A2:2020) for software for railway control and protection systems, and EN 50129:2018 and EN 50129:2026 for safety-related electronic systems for signalling, plus the free CSM regulations and ORR guidance that cover the risk-process need. Contains no source content: each row carries only the designation, title, edition, owner, redistributability status, and an official URL. Use when you need to identify, cite, or locate one of these documents. No in-repo pack covers these standards.
